column3: `Club_Records::update_league_position_records(league, all_time)`: sorts the table of each league stage and stores each club's best and worst league position for the season and, with the second argument, all time (queueing the news item for a human club or national side). \n A null league, or one whose +0x44 is not 0xff, gives the error boxes and 0. In each league of the chain (league_stage_chain) it sorts the table (0x6827d0) and, for each row that has games (+0x11) and a club, through the season records (0x4528d0) and the all-time records (0x452710, created when missing): best position (type 1, 0x449590) and worst (type 2). The position is written when there is no record yet (−1), when the competition (the id of the first league) has a higher reputation (best) or a lower one (worst), or when it is the same competition with a better or worse position: it stores the position (+0/+7), the competition (+1/+8) and the year (+5/+0xc; 0 for the season, 0x669950 for all time). For all time (with `all_time`; an id above [0xae2378] also counts as "no record"), the news queue (club_records_queue_record_news). Returns 1.

`Club_Records::send_record_news()` (SEH frame without a destructor): delivers the news item of each queued record (human club or national side) and empties the queue. \n Without a queue (+0x24), returns 1. For each record in the queue (6 bytes: club id, type, period at +5) of a human club (0x7875e0) or a national side (0x53b900): the news item 0x3e8 (local) is filled by 0x453120 with the season record (period 2, 0x4528d0) or the all-time record (0x452710), without creating them; it is delivered to the nation (0x7863f0) of the national side or to the club's manager (0x7861e0). A queue with capacity (+0x28) of 100 or more is freed (0x9452ca) and +0x24/+0x28 are zeroed. The count (+0x2c) goes back to 0. Returns 1.

`Club_Records::pick_fans_player_of_year(club, record)`: picks the fans' player of the year from the club's squad: the best score among the players with games above the minimum; stores his reference at record +0x371 and returns 1, or 0. \n Without games (signed +0x10 of the club's 106-byte entry in [this+0x1c]) and with reputation (+0x80) below 3000, returns 0. With the factor 0.6, falling by 0.1 while nobody has been chosen and it is above 0.2: the minimum number of games is +0x10 × factor (_ftol); among the 50 squad slots (+0xd7), the players (+0x61, id below [0xae2364]) of the club (+0x39) with statistic 6 (0x7c3920 over [0xb74350]) whose games are above 0 and above the minimum (signed 16 bits), the one with the highest score (`fan_rating`: average + 0.025 × +2 + 1/60 × +6, club and player likes; it must be above −1000). Nobody: 0; otherwise his reference (0x7e4920) at record +0x371 and 1.

`Club_Records::update_transfer_fee_records(transfer)`: updates the buyer's paid record and the seller's received record, for the season and all time (fee, reference, other club, date, loan). \n The person (+0xc) and the buying club (+8); the person's contract (0x4cf5a0 over [0xae1050], kept in [0xae1080]) gives the seller (+4). The buyer's season (0x4528d0) and all-time (0x452710) records are fetched (created when missing); without a seller, returns 1. A fee (+0x1b) above the season paid record (+0x313) becomes the record: the fee, the person's reference (0x7e4920), the seller, today's date and the loan flag (+4 ≠ 0); if it is above the all-time record it is copied there, and if it passes 1000 × (reputation + 300): the record goes to the news queue (0x452cb0, 0x1c, if it is not there yet) and the manager (+0xbf) comes to favour the person (0x547a10, forced). The same for the seller in the received record (+0x33c; the queue with 0x1d, without the favouring). Returns 1.

`Club_Records::add_transfer_totals(fee, buyer, seller)`: adds the fee to the seller's season income and the buyer's season spending, raises the all-time records and queues the record news (0x1f, 0x1e) above (+0x80 + 500) × 1000. \n The seller adds `fee` to the income for the season (+0x36b of the season record 0x4528d0; −1 = nothing yet: the fee is stored) and zeroes the year (+0x36f); above the all-time record (0x452710, same field), the record becomes the season one with the club's season year (0x669950), and with the total at least (club +0x80 + 500) × 1000 and the year different from the record's, the record news item 0x1f (0x452cb0) if it is not in the queue yet. The buyer does the same for spending (+0x365, year +0x369, news 0x1e), but the minimum is checked against the OLD record and without the year. The records are created when missing (second argument 1). A null buyer or seller: nothing, 1. Returns 1.

`club_records_update_career_records(player, club, games, goals)`: updates the club's all-time league appearances (+0x247) and goals (+0x261) records, with the player reference (0x7e4920), when the record type applies to the club (0x449590). \n In the club's all-time records (0x452710, created when missing), if type 0x17 applies to the club (0x449590) and `games` beats the record (+0x247; −1 = no record), the record = `games` and the player's reference goes to +0x249 (0x7e4920); the same with type 0x18 and `goals` (+0x261, reference +0x263). Returns 1. A null player or club, or no record: the "Error" box (lines 0x6fa and 0x702) and 0.

`Club_Records::update_season_rating_record(club)`: the squad player with the best average rating (statistic 0x11) among those who played at least half the games becomes the season rating record. \n With games in the season (byte +0x10 of the club's entry, [this+0x1c] + id × 0x6a) and the season record (0x4528d0, without creating), the record rating (+0x1f1) goes back to −1.0 and, over the 50 squad slots (+0xd7), the player (not a human manager: id < [0xae2364]) with statistics (+0x61) at the club (+0x39 = the club or the one linked to it, 0x540a50) and a season statistics record (0x7c3920, type 6) who played at least half the games (statistic 1, truncated, 0x7c2150 with 6.5) and has the highest average (statistic 0x11) becomes the record: the rating (+0x1f1, float), the games (+0x20d), the reference (+0x1f5, 0x7e4920) and +0x20e = 0. Returns 1 if someone became the record. Without games or without a record: 0. A null club: the original routine (box 0x16f2, 0).

`Club_Records::get_all_time_record(club, create)`: returns the club's all-time records: index +0 of its entry ([this+0x1c] + id × 0x6a) into the vector [this+4] of 0x38b-byte records. \n Without an index (−1) and with `create`: the new index is the count (+0xc, which goes up), the vector grows by 50 at a time (capacity +8, realloc 0x945667; without memory, box 0x1694 and the end) and the record is reset (0x452fe0). Returns the record, or 0 without an index. A null club: the original routine (box 0x1680, 0).

`Club_Records::get_season_record(club, create)`: the same as `get_all_time_record` for the season records: index +4 of the entry, vector [this+0x10], capacity +0x14, count +0x18 (without memory, box 0x16c9 and the end). A null club: the original routine (box 0x16b5, 0).

`Club_Records::queue_record_news(id, type)`: appends (club id at +0, record type at +4; byte +5 is left as it is) to the 6-byte vector [this+0x24] of record news, read by 0x448e30. \n When full (count +0x2c = capacity +0x28) it grows by 5 at a time (realloc 0x945667); without memory, box 0x174f and returns 0 (the game goes on, without the vector). Returns 1.

`Club_Records::offer_breaks_fee_record(offer, require)`: tells whether the offer fee (+0x1b) beats the fee-paid record of the buying club (+8; the all-time records through 0x452710, creating them if needed). \n It must be at least 50 × reputation (+0x80) + 500,000; with `require`, also at least reputation² × the constant 0x967880 (_ftol); and above zero and above the record (+0x313). A null offer: 0.

`transfer_fee_record_construct`: constructs the highest transfer fee paid record: the dates at +0x14 and +0x20 (0x54a110). \n The original's SEH frame only covers the 2nd date (0x54a110 does not fail). Returns `this`.

`oldest_player_record_construct`: constructs the oldest player record: the age (+0), the record holder's date (+0x18) and the match date (+0x20) (0x54a110). \n The original's SEH frame is not needed (0x54a110 does not fail). Returns `this`.

`transfer_fee_record_assign`: copies the transfer fee record (0x29 bytes) from `source`: five dwords (+0..+0x10: the fee, the player, the other club...), the date at +0x14, the dword +0x1c, the date at +0x20 and the part-exchange flag (+0x28). Returns `this`.

`goals_in_match_record_assign`: copies the goals-in-a-match record (0x38 bytes) from `source`: the goals (+0, byte), the record holder at +1 (0x448490) and the match record at +0x19 (0x448110, both already in Rust). Returns `this`.

Copies the match record (0x1f bytes) from `source`: the date, the opponent, the score and the fixture fields. \n The date at +0, then +8 (dword), +0xc and +0xe (words), +0x10 (byte), +0x11 and +0x15 (dwords), +0x19 and +0x1a (bytes) and +0x1b (dword). Returns `this`.

`update_for_date(today, full)` (virtual +0x14): the Copa Mercosur's day. Rule: the Mercosur has 20 invited clubs (the clubs the South American rules invite, shuffled) in 5 groups of 4 [inference: six rounds on Tuesdays, from 29 July to 14 October]; the season turns on 1 June; on the draw day group 1 stays in the cup's own table (drawn clubs 0 to 3) and groups 2 to 5 are stages (4g + 4 to 4g + 7); the 5 winners and the 3 best runners-up go to the quarter-finals. \n First the turn of the season: on 1 June of today's year (the date from 0x549f70(1, 5, year, −1): lea ecx, local; push −1; push year; push 5; push 1 -> thiscall, ret 0x10, pure: the day of the year from the month tables, the month counted from 0), if the cup's year (+0x40, signed) is not today's, virtual +8 (the new season: mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 0). \n When the draw has not been done (+0x45 = 0) and with `full`, on the draw day (the date from 0x549ef0(+0xb6, +0xb8 + +0x40): the day of the year and the relative year; compared with today's, +0 the day of the year and +2 the year, unsigned): the clubs (0x4c5850, the 20 invited clubs shuffled: mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 0), the group 1 table (0x4c4e60, thiscall, ret 0; 0: the box of line 0x396), the fixtures (0x6835c0 League::create_fixtures, thiscall, ret 0; 0: the box of line 0x39b), the sorted table (0x6827d0 push 0; mov ecx -> thiscall, ret 4; 0: the box of line 0x3a1), the stages of groups 0..3 (0x4c51d0: push g; mov ecx -> thiscall, ret 4), the predicted positions (virtual +0x5c, thiscall, ret 0), the list +0xee freed (0x9452ca: push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl) and zeroed, and +0x45 = 1. An error gives the box of its line and goes on. Then the league day (0x6847c0: push full; push today; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 8), whose return value it passes on.

Builds the table of group 1 of the Copa Mercosur. Rule: group 1 has 4 clubs, the first 4 drawn, each in the row of its order; human managers get the group draw news. \n 4 teams (+0x3e), the table +0xb1 (0x944e46(0xec): push 0xec; add esp, 4 -> cdecl; 4 rows of 0x3b bytes; without memory, the box of line 0x155 and returns 0), each row i with drawn club i (+0xee) (0x687430 League::init_table_row: push 0; push 0; push club; push i; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 0x10), the group draw news (0x684230: mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 0), and returns 1. The same body as 0x4019c0 of the African Cup (only the file and the box line change).

Creates the stage of group g + 1 of the Copa Mercosur (g from 0 to 3, on the draw day). Rule: each of the other groups is a league stage with the next 4 drawn clubs (4g + 4 to 4g + 7), the cup's rules and year and the cup's round table for the group; human managers get the news. \n SEH frame only for the stage's new: no destructor on the normal path. The teams go into a vector of +0x3e pointers (0x944e46(+0x3e << 2): push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl; without memory, the box of line 0x1fb and 0): drawn clubs 4g + 4 to 4g + 7 (+0xee); the round table through virtual +0x3c (push 0; push &id; push &rounds; push g; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 0x10); the stage (0x944cf1(0xee) push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl; the League_Stage constructor 0x68b100, thiscall, ret 0x58, 22 arguments: the cup, the teams (+0x3e, word), the vector, +0x3c (word), +4, the round table, the rounds (word), +0xc2, +0xc3, +0xc4, &+0xc5, &+0xbe, the year +0x40 (word), g, the id (word), +0x51, 2, 0, +0xd9 (word), −1, 0, 2; the original pushes the words and bytes with garbage in the high bytes, which the constructor does not read: the port passes clean values) in [+0xc][g]; the vector and the round table freed (0x9452ca). Without a stage: the box of line 0x211 and 0. With it: the group news (0x684230 on the stage), +0x30 = g and 1.

`Friendly::on_friendly_fixture_cancelled(fixture, cancelling_club)` (SEH frame for the local news item), called by the calendar (0x5aa680) and by the club screen: handles a cancelled friendly fixture. \n A friendly of this competition (+0x14 = +4): news item 8 (0x77bbe0) with +0xc, +0x10, the day and the year, to the managers of the home and away clubs that did not cancel (0x7861e0); of another competition: that competition's tournament among those at +0xb1 (0x69 bytes; index = competition byte − +0xaf), if flagged, is cancelled (0x5c8260 with 0). A friendly of this competition with the slot list (+0x34cc): the fixture's slot (0x5c6740) is freed (+0x10 = 0, +0x18 = 0). A fixture without a round (+0x43 = 0xff): the national team one goes through 0x5cb9e0, the club one only leaves the calendar (0x5abc30).

Cancels a national team friendly (from 0x5c6570; SEH frame for the local list and dates): the national team's fixture on the previous day leaves the calendar, then the fixture itself leaves. \n By the fixture flag (+0x4d & 0x300): 0x100 the national team is the home side (+0x1c), 0x200 the first national team of its nation (0x53b4f0); with a valid id, its fixture on the previous day (0x549ef0, 0x54c8e0 with 1, 0x417c10; 0x5acbe0 with the previous day at both ends) leaves the calendar (0x5abc30). Then the fixture itself leaves.

`Friendly::cancel_tournament(tournament, without_owner)` (SEH frame for the local news item, dates and list), called by the cancelled friendly (0x5c6570) and by the friendlies' day: cancels a friendly tournament. \n Without a tournament, the box of line 0x10ad. If the tournament starts after a week ago (0x54c8e0 with 7), news item 0xb (the owner, the start day and year +4/+6) goes to the invited clubs (+0x15, 4) that did not refuse (+0x25 = 1, except the owner) and to the owner if `without_owner` is 0. The tournament leaves the pending list (+0x34d0, 0x68d1f0). With the competition created (+0x65): its fixtures from a week before to 10 days after the start (0x5acbe0): today's one becomes a friendly again (0x5ac7a0: +0x42 = 0xff, +0x14 = the friendlies competition, +0 = [0x9cf668]); the others leave the calendar (0x5abc30) and, those with a round, come back as friendlies (0x5ab230). The competition is destroyed (virtual +0 with 1) and +0x65 = 0. The slot in the competitions table (+0xaf + byte +0x64) and the owner (+0) are zeroed.

`friendly_check_match_invitation(a, b, club, day, year, date, text, size)` (SEH frame for the local LLIST 0x68d020/0x68d040), called by the invitation news item (0x77bc80, 0x782b70): tells whether the friendly invitation still holds. \n With a text and a size (word) below 100: the box of line 0x1527 and 1 (the original). Without the date: with a text, club `a`'s fixtures (+0 id) on the day (day, year; 0x5acbe0 into a local list) say whether the friendly was arranged (the first fixture is `a` against `b`) or cancelled (0x66f4e0 into the text); returns 0. With the date: before today + 2 days (0x54c5b0), cancelled (with text) and 0; the club free on the date (0x5c6b70 with type 0): 1; otherwise, with text, "{} ... are unavailable" (byte +0x52 twice and the name +0x38) and 0.

`friendly_check_tournament_invitation(club, tournament, text, size)`, called by the tournament invitation news item: tells whether the tournament invitation still holds. \n With a text and a size below 100: the box of line 0x1575 and 1 (the original). Without a tournament or with its date (+4) before today + 2 days: "This competition has been cancelled" (with text) and 0. The club free on the date (0x5c6b70 with type +0xc): 1; otherwise, with text, "{} ... are unavailable for this competition." and 0.

`Friendly::build_international_date_table()`, called by the friendlies competition constructor (0x5c1f80, at game creation): builds the table of the 110 international dates. \n Count 0xc8 in +0x34f0 and the 0xfa0-byte table (malloc 0x944e46: push n; add esp, 4 -> cdecl) in +0x34ec (without memory: the box of line 0x15d5, count 0: the original); writes the 110 dates of 20 bytes (weekday, day, month, year offset from the World Cup year, confederation and qualifying competition; the first 105 directly, the last 5 through 0x5cb9b0: mov ecx, entry; 6 pushes; no add esp -> thiscall, ret 0x18); with the count below 110 (never: it is the 0xc8 above) the box of line 0x15d8; count 110, the table shrunk to 0x898 bytes (realloc 0x945667: 2 pushes; add esp, 8 -> cdecl), the dates resolved in the World Cup cycle (0x5cc510: mov ecx, esi; no push -> thiscall) and the last day done (+0x34f4) = 400.

`Friendly::resolve_international_dates()`, called by the table builder (0x5ca4f0): gives each entry its date in the World Cup cycle and sorts the table by date. \n The World Cup year: the first one from today's year ([0xae2c92]) on with (year − 2) a multiple of 4. Each date (+0x34ec, count +0x34f0) gets its date at +3 through 0x54a130 (lea ecx, entry + 3; 4 pushes; no add esp -> thiscall(date, day, month, year, weekday), ret 0x10) with the day (+1) and the weekday (+0) as signed bytes, the month (+2) and the World Cup year plus +0xb (signed), less 4 if it is more than 3 years ahead of today (words). Then the qsort by date (0x945333: 4 pushes; add esp, 0x10 -> cdecl(table, count, 0x14, 0x5cc610)).

`Friendly::find_human_club_tournament()`, called by the friendlies screens: returns the tournament in use that the current human manager's club hosts, or 0. \n The club (+0x39) of the current human manager ([0xb74c26 + 0x300 × [0xb77c7a]]); among the 127 tournaments (0x69 bytes from +0xb1), the first with that host (+0) and in use (+0x29 ≠ 0): its pointer; otherwise 0.

`Friendly::plan_club_friendlies(entries, sorted, count)`, called by the AI pre-season plan (0x5c27a0): rebuilds the friendly plan (+0x34d8), giving the AI clubs of each league in pre-season friendlies on free dates; at the end the plan is sorted by date. \n Frees the old plan (+0x34d8; free 0x9452ca, cdecl), allocates the new one (malloc 0x944e46 of 2000 bytes, cdecl; without memory the box of line 0x6f1), capacity +0x34e4 = 100, count +0x34e0 and +0x34dc zeroed. For each of the 35 active leagues (0xb63d60, 0x48 bytes) of a nation with +0x11c, whose season (+0x2a) has not started and whose date +0x39 minus 0x34 (0x54cab0: lea ecx, [league + 0x39]; 2 pushes; no add esp -> thiscall) has already arrived: the nation's candidates (bsearch 0x946464: 5 pushes; add esp, 0x14 -> cdecl, through 0x5c5290; it steps back to the nation's first one; the last one in the list never gets in) up to the first one of another nation. Each club that is not human (0x600a50: 5 pushes; add esp, 0x14 -> cdecl(club, 1, 1, 0, 0)), is not the one with +0x1db = [0x9cf6f8] and has a league (+0x57) registered in [0xadadfc]: band = reputation / 500 + (draw(3) + 1, where 3 becomes 2 when draw(4) is zero); up to draw(3) + 4 friendlies (by the candidate's count +4): the opponent (0x5c4cb0: 5 pushes; ecx = this -> thiscall) and, when found, the friendly on a free date (0x5c4380: 3 pushes; ecx = this -> thiscall) with the one of higher band (+5) as host and home side; with no opponent or with the friendly booked, the band × 0.8 (at least 1). At the end, the qsort of the plan by date (0x945333: 4 pushes; add esp, 0x10 -> cdecl, through 0x778e90).

`Friendly::add_tournament(host, type, start, a, b, c, d, e, invited, name)`, called by the AI tournament (0x5c3be0) and by the club screens (0x4701f0): fills the first free tournament of the 127, or returns 0 with no free slot. \n The tournament gets the host (+0), the type (+0xc), bytes a and b (+0xd, +0xe), the start date (+4, through 0x417c10: lea ecx, [t + 4]; 2 pushes; no add esp -> thiscall), words c, d, e (+0xf, +0x11, +0x13), +0x29, +0x2d and +0x65 zeroed, the name (+0x31, with the terminating zero) and the 4 invited clubs (+0x15, dwords) with the flags +0x25..+0x28 set to 1.

`Friendly::find_human_club_open_invitation()`, called by the friendlies screens: returns the friendly in the list (+0x34c8) that the current human manager's club requested and that still waits for an opponent, or 0. \n With the friendlies list (+0x34c8) and the club (+0x39) of the current human manager ([0xb74c26 + 0x300 × [0xb77c7a]]): the list cursor (+0xa) goes back to the start (+2) and, walking with the list's next (0x68d1b0: ecx = the list; no push -> thiscall), the first friendly of that club (+0xc) still without a date (+8 ≠ 0); otherwise 0.

`Friendly::process_friendly_reply(request, force)` (SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path): the invited club decides on a friendly request and the requester is told. \n Without a requester (+0xc): nothing. With the other club (+0x10, or +0x14 if +0x10 is the requester) in status 1 and without a human manager (0x600a50), or with `force`: if either has no nation, status 4 (overwritten right after); the decision (friendly_reply: by reputation, with the nation, region, continent and stadium city distance factor) writes 3 or 4 into +0x18 and news item 7 goes to the requester. Accepted (3): the friendly's match in a 0x4f-byte local (the competition [+4] and its id, the stadium of club +0x10 (+0x69) and its id, clubs +0x10 and +0x14 and their ids, the request date, today's year, 9 for a national side (0x53b900) or 1, kick-off time 1 on Saturday and Sunday (0x54a3f0 = 5 or 6) or 2, the flags, −1 in the scores) goes to the calendar (0x5aa680: push 1; push &local; ecx = [0xae2a58] -> thiscall, ret 8). With 3 or 4: the booked friendly's slot (0x5c6740) gets +0x18 = 3, or +0x10 = 0 and +0x18 = 0, and the request is removed (0x5c87b0 with 0). In any other status, the request only leaves the reply list (+0x34d4; 0x68d1f0, with the cursor +0xa reset to the start before, after each one and at the end).

`Friendly::send_friendly_request(request)` (SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path): stores the request on the reply list and notifies a human invited club. \n Without the reply list (+0x34d4), creates it (0x944cf1(0xe): push 0xe; add esp, 4 -> cdecl; 0x68d020: ecx = the block -> thiscall, ret 0); without memory, the box (line 0x982) and nothing more. Stores the request pointer in the list (0x68d0d0: push 4; push &request; ecx = the list -> thiscall, ret 8). With the other club in status 1 and with a human manager: status 2 and, if +0x10 or +0x14 has a human manager, news item 6 to the other one.

`Friendly::build_nation_list()`: builds the list (+0x34fa) of nations with a continent, sorted by reputation. \n +0x34fe = 0; allocates [0xae2350] × 4 bytes (0x944e46: push n; add esp, 4 -> cdecl) at +0x34fa (without memory, the box, line 0x15af); puts into it the nations with a continent (+0x71), counting in +0x34fe, and sorts them by reputation (0x945333 with 0x5cc5f0).

`Friendly::update_for_date(today, active)`: the friendlies' day: on the pre-season days plans the AI friendlies and cancels old tournaments; every day creates the planned friendlies, answers requests and expires tournaments, requests and invitations. \n With `active`, on the two pre-season days (+0x34ea, +0x34e8) and with the game start [0xdd6ec8] up to today + 8 weeks (0x54c770; after that, nothing more on the day): stores today in +0xa7, plans the AI pre-season (0x5c27a0) and cancels (0x5c8260) the tournaments in use (+0x65) dated more than a year ago (0x54cab0, 0x456770). Every day: creates the planned friendlies (0x5c2ae0), updates the national teams' friendlies (0x5cbb00), takes out and answers the tournament replies (+0x34d0, 0x5c5820) and answers the friendly replies (+0x34d4, 0x5c5f40), removes the requests without clubs or expired (+0x34c8), cancels the tournaments not in use whose date − 2 days (0x54c8e0) has passed and zeroes the expired invitations (+0x34cc, 10 items of 0x19 bytes, the date at +9, the flag at +0x15). Returns 1.

`Friendly::plan_ai_preseason_friendlies()`: builds one candidate per club with a nation, sorts them, sets the windows and plans tournaments, tours and friendlies. \n Builds a 0x16-byte candidate (+0 the club id, +4 zero, +5 the band = reputation +0x80 / 500, +6 the nation id, +0xa and +0x12 null lists, +0xe/+0x10 the window −1) for each club ([0xae23b4], 0x245 bytes, [0xae235c] of them) that is not a national side (0x53b900) and has a nation; sorts the candidates by band (qsort 0x945333 with 0x5c5270) and a pointer vector by nation and band (0x5c5290); sets the windows (0x5c2d40), plans tournaments and tours (0x5c3040) and the friendlies (0x5c4770); frees the candidates' lists (0x68d040 + 0x944c94) and the two vectors (0x9452ca). `CONTRACT_MANAGER::calc_player_value(person, club, mode, ability, _)`: the player value by peak age and age, record ratings, ability as seen by the club manager, club nation, contract days left and release clause. \n The main contract goes to [0xae1080] and the contract with his club (0x4cf5f0, into the incoming `this`). Without a player sheet (+0x61): the compensation (0x8d0780 with 1) by the contract club, or 0. The base and the peak age by the sheet's positions (+0x15/+0x14/+0x13/+0x12 ≥ 15: 13, 11, 10, 9 million; goalkeeper +0xf = 20: 6 million, 33; otherwise 8 million; peak 28 or 29). The age factor (peak − age, with the correction above [0x9688a0]) × the sheet's ratings (+0x28, +0x27, +0x43, +0x36, +0x2f, outside goalkeepers) and +0x2d²; the reputation (+9) limits the factor. The ability: without a club, the current one (+0xb); with a club, the one seen by the manager (0x6e86d0 if `ability` = −1, with the seen reputation 0x5407e0) × 50 + the reputation + up to 5000 × factor, × [0x968f08], between 1 and 12000; the potential (+0xd) above 5000 (and 8000) before the peak pulls it up. \n Value = ability² × base × the table 0x9a7f30 (by age, with experience +0x22/+0x1a) × the club's nation (+0x53: +0x7e and +0x85 or the division +0x69; without a club, draw(3) + 1), with a floor. `mode`: the nation [0x9cf434] and the clause. Otherwise: the contract days (with the Bosman rule 0x8d0a70) and the nations [0x9cf434], [0x9cf300], [0x9cf484]; at the end the active release clause (0x867b50) limits it.

`contract_manager_write_morale_comparison_text(a, b, out, _)` (stdcall, ret 0x10): writes the morale difference of two players as a word, for the comparison screen. \n The difference of the morales (+0x45 of the sheets, a − b, as a byte) becomes "Superior" (down to −14 and from 13), "Better" (−13 to −8 and 7 to 12), "Marginal" (−7 to −4 and 3 to 6) or "Same" (−3 to 2) in the output (0x66f4e0 with 0xad9c64); returns the difference (the game reads al).

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::get_squad_flags_for_club(person, club)`, called by the club screens: returns the squad flags the club screen shows. \n The person's squad flags (+0x5e without the national side bits, & 0xf3), unless she is on loan (second contract, +4 of the 79-byte record) to a club other than `club` or its partner (0x540a50): with a partner, 1; otherwise 2 with bit 0x40 of +0x35 of the main contract (the reserve bit), 1 without. Without a club, the "Error" box (the original). The game reads al.

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::post_wants_new_contract_news(contract)` (SEH frame for the local news item), called by the daily staff pass (0x5ce2d0): posts news item 0xbc2, that the player wants a new contract, to the club manager, unless he is transfer listed or in an offer. \n Without a contract: the "Error" box (line 0x2d91). A person on the transfer list (0x8c1870), with offers (0x8c5cf0) or offered in exchange (0x8c5e40): nothing. Otherwise news item 0xbc2 to the manager of the contract club (0x7861e0): the club, the person, the squad status (+0x4f >> 4), 0, the contract end (+0x2d signed day, +0x2f year), the wage (+0xc) and, in slot 11, 1 if the adaptability (+0x59) is below 10, +0x5b below 5 and the sheet's reputation (+0xd) above 4750.

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::post_transfer_request_withdrawn_news(contract, reason)` (SEH frame for the local news item): posts news item 0xbc0 of a withdrawn transfer request, with the reason, to the club manager. \n Without a contract: the "Error" box (line 0x2ba6). Otherwise news item 0xbc0 to the manager of the contract club (0x7861e0): the club, the person, the reason and, in slot 7, 1 if the contract's +0x3f is above 1.

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::post_contract_expiry_news(contract, period, bosman, notify_interested)` (SEH frame for the local news item and list), called by the contracts pass: posts news item 0xbbd of an expiring contract to the club manager and, if asked, to interested clubs of active nations. \n Without a contract: the "Error" box (line 0x24f0). Otherwise news item 0xbbd to the club's manager (0x7861e0): the club, the person, the period (signed), `bosman` and, in slot 8, whether the person has a player sheet (+0x61). With `notify_interested` (cancelled if the club's nation, +0x53, is not active, 0x544670): the clubs interested in the player (0x842180 into a local LLIST, with 1, 1, 0) from another active nation also get it.

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::post_bosman_departure_news(contract, destination)` (SEH frame for the local news item): posts news item 0xbbe of a Bosman departure. \n Without a contract: the "Error" box (line 0x2611). Otherwise news item 0xbbe to the club's manager (0x7861e0): the club, the person and the destination club (−1 without one).

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::add_contract_offer(terms, slot, value, flag, a5, decide, agreed)` (SEH frame without a destructor), called by the loan offer (0x8bed60), the stored offers (0x4cf4a0), the lists (0x84a020), the negotiation (0x4cda70) and the screen: updates the same club's offer to the person or adds a new one to the list; marks the terms as offered on the transfer offer and, if asked, schedules the decision. \n Computes today + 14 (0x54c5b0, discarded) and builds a local 0x6f-byte record (contract 0x85e410, date 0x54a110). With counted offers (+8 of the person's 79-byte record in [0xae2d0c]) and a list (+0x34), the offer from the same club is updated: the terms (the inlined operator= 0x4cc810), +0x50 = 2 if `agreed` (otherwise 0), +0x51 = today, +0x59 the slot, +0x5d the value, +0x61 the flag, +0x62 = 1 outside a type 6 contract. Otherwise the local record gets the same (+0x63 = −1, the rest left as the original leaves it) and goes into the list (created when missing; 0x68d0d0), and the offer count goes up. With a slot, the offer (0x8c61e0) of the same player marks the terms as offered (0x8c1f80), otherwise the exchange player (0x8c2060); with `decide`, it schedules the decision (0x4cd230).

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::remove_contract_offer_for_transfer(person, slot)`, called by the withdrawn and undone offers (0x8bf680, 0x8bfcb0, 0x8c4950, 0x8c4e10, 0x8d0f70, 0x8df9b0): removes the person's contract offer linked to the transfer slot and lowers the offer count. \n In the list of contract offers (+0x34; cursor restarted), the person's one with the slot (+0x59). When found: with +0x63 flagged, the original 0x7a81a0 of [0xb7434c] with +0x63, +0x67 and +0x6b; if agreed (+0x50 = 2), it clears the agreed-contract flag (0x8c5430); removes it from the list (0x68d1f0) and the person's offer count (+8 of the 79-byte record) goes down.

The lowest wage the person asks of the club (stdcall, ret 8; SEH frame without a destructor), for the contract screen: the lower of the desired wages for squad status 1 and 2 at the club, at most 10 million. \n In a local contract (0x85e410), the desired one (0x85fc50 with −1, status 1 and then 2, 0xb), at most 10 million.

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::handle_transfer_request(contract)` (SEH frame for the local news item): handles a player's transfer request. \n A null contract: the "Error" box 0x2999. A person without a player sheet (+0x61): nothing. A human club (0x7875e0): the request news item (0xbbf), built on the stack (by the original). At a computer club, outside squad status 1 (+0x4f & 0xf0 = 0x10): if the value (0x4d0c60) × 1.5 beats the asking price (0x4d1600), the club lists him (+0x4e: clears bit 2 and sets 8; morale +12 in 0x544710; the club lists 0x842c00; 0x4d71b0). Otherwise a draw by the request strength (+0x44) and the temperament (+0x59) against another of 50 gives the 0x10000 grievance (0x867700); the morale drops 12 and the request strength grows by temperament × 5 + 56, held at ±100.

`compare_decision_dates(a, b)` (cdecl): the qsort order of the decision dates (14-byte entries: +0 person, +4 date, +0xc time slice of the day, +0xd type). \n `a`'s date earlier (0x456770): −1; later (0x456740): 1; on the same day, `a`'s slice minus `b`'s (signed). Hot (the qsort): no counter.

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::get_current_contract_offers(club, out)`: copies the club's open contract offers into a new array of 111 bytes per offer and returns how many. \n It walks the offers list (+0x34; cursor reset, 0x68d1b0) and copies each offer of the club (+4 = id) outside states 5 and 6 (+0x35 & 0x3f) into a new vector of 111 bytes per offer, which grows by 20 at a time (realloc 0x945667 with the capacity as a signed byte). Stores the vector in `out` and returns how many (byte). After the realloc the original checks the list (+0x34), not the vector: only with a null list does it go to the "cannot allocate memory" box (line 0x64c) and return 0 with a null output. The caller (0x598a06, the transfer budget) frees the vector.

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::sign_loan_contract(contract)` (SEH frame with only a local date, no destructor): moves the person to the loan club, marks the reserve bit in the main contract and stores the loan contract in her slot; recalculates the wage bills. \n The person (+0) of the new loan contract and her club by the main contract (the record [0xae1080]); without it, nothing. Keeps the person's date +0x3e, takes her off the lists (0x7c5fe0 with the new club +4), checks the main contract in the array itself (without it, the box of line 0x16a9 and nothing more) and sets in it bit 0x40 of +0x35 (in the reserves): with a reserve team (0x542740), by the squad mark +0x5e & 1; with a partner club (0x540a50), if the current club (+0x39) is not the owner; otherwise clears it. Notifies the new club (0x90d860), takes the person out of the current club's tactics (0x896c60 with 0 and 1), puts her into the new club as a player (0x53bd10, job 0xb with today's date) and restores the date +0x3e. \n The contract goes into the person's loan slot (+4 of the 79-byte record): the one she already has; otherwise the first free one (−1) of the array, which takes the index (and then the original leaves without redoing the wage bills); otherwise at the end (full: +100 slots, realloc 0x945667 or malloc 0x944e46; without memory, the box of line 0x1708 and it goes on), through STAFF_CONTRACT::operator= 0x4cc810. Finally it redoes the wage bills of the owning club and the new one.

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::end_loan(person)`: takes the person out of the loan club, frees the loan contract, recalculates the wage bills and returns her to the parent club with the squad mark. \n The loan club (+0x39; null: the box of line 0x1729), or its A team when it is the B team (0x540a50). With the main contract in the array itself (without it: the box of line 0x1735): the record [0xae1080] gives the owning club; takes the person off the lists (0x7c5fe0 with the owner), the disputes (0x556570), the loan club's tactics (0x896c60 with 0 and 1); frees the loan contract (−1 in the entry and in slot +4); removes her from the loan club's squad (0x53c190); redoes the wage bills of the loan club and the owner; removes her from the loan club's shortlist (0x849ce0, 0x843e10 with 4). The person goes back to the owner (+0x39) and to the squad marks (0x540980): with a reserve team (0x542740), 2 if the main contract has bit 0x40 of +0x35, otherwise 1; otherwise 1 and, with a partner club, she stays at the partner if she is in its 50 slots. Status +0x6d 0x10 becomes 4.

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::toggle_squad_placement(person, club, out)`: moves the person between the club's first team and reserves or between the club and its partner (A/B side), taking the loan contract into account; 0 with no room at the destination. \n By the place (0x4cbb60): 0 nothing. 1 and 2 (first team / reserves at the club): on loan to another club (loan contract +4 with another club), it only clears (1) or sets (2) bit 0x40 of +0x35 of the main contract; otherwise squad mark 1 or 2 (0x540980) and the club's tactics (0x896c60 with 1 or 0). 3 (B team) and the others (A team): the destination club is the club (3) or the partner (0x540a50), stored in `out`; with no room for the job (+0x3d, 0x53b9a0) it returns 0. On loan to this club: she leaves the other's lists, squad and tactics and enters the destination with the job; with another club's loan contract: toggles bit 0x40 and moves to the destination as a player (0xb); otherwise as the loaned one, without storing. Returns 1 (also for a null club). Without a main contract the original reads [0x35] and crashes.

`staff_can_take_job(job, person)` (stdcall, ret 8): tells whether the person fits the job (6 to 15) by age, current job and the player and non-player records; a null person: 0. \n Through the jump table 0x4cbaf4 (job − 6, 0..9; outside: 0); 7, 12 and 14: 0; a null person: 0 (the non-player regen 0x7ab9f2 always asks with null). 6: aged 30 (+0x18) or more, a non-player (+0x69), above 36, or with +0x57 below 10 and the player's +0x2f 12 or more: 1; otherwise, a non-player in job 8, 6 or 5. 8: aged 30, a non-player or above 36 or (+0x2f ≥ 12 and +0x57 < 10) outside jobs 5 and 10: 1; otherwise as for 6. 9: a non-player in job 9. 10: a non-player in job 10 or with +0x28 = 10. 11: a player (+0x61). 13 and 15: both player and non-player, or above 34, or aged 30 with +0x2f ≥ 12.

`contract_manager_lower_match_morale(person, club, contract)`: lowers the player's contract morale after a poor match (by rating, reputation, time at the club, age and contract band) and, with very low morale, may add the wants-to-leave or lack-of-games grievance; injured, on loan or retiring clears the grievances. \n The drop `m` (match_morale_drop). Injured (0x62c400), on loan (loan contract), retiring (0x7a7eb0), under 18 or with +0x49: clears grievances 4 and 0x10 (0x8674e0). Otherwise, with m > 5 and morale − m below −30 − +0x59: above 21 years old, stronger (+0xb) than the club and above 2250, or with potential (+0xd) above reputation − 1500 and above 500 with draw(+0x57) ≠ 0 and +0x3d negative: in the transfer window of the contract club, grievance 4 (0x8674e0 and 0x867700 with 4); in the first team (0x4cbb60 = 1), rating above 1250, more than 23 years old and draw(+0x59 + 5) = 0: grievance 0x10; up to 21 years old, in the first team with draw(+0x57) > 5, stronger than the club and above 1250: grievance 0x10. Finally the happiness in the contract (+0x44) drops by m, kept between −100 and 100.

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::remove_contract(person)`: frees the person's main contract entry, puts −1 in her slot of the 79-byte record and recalculates the wage bill of the contract's club. \n With the main contract (index in the person's 79-byte record), it frees its entry (+0 = −1 in the CONTRACT_MANAGER's 0x50-byte vector), puts −1 in the person's slot and redoes the wage bill (0x598370) of the finances (0x5a0590) of the contract club (+4). Without a contract: nothing.

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::resubmit_held_offers(id)`: resubmits the person's held offers as live offers, removes each one from the list and returns how many. \n It walks the held offers list (+0x38) and, for each one of person `id` (+0): with the transfer (+0x59, 0x8c61e0 over [0xde1f54]) whose club (+0x24) is the offer's (+0x5d), it sets state 0xf to 8 and resubmits the offer (0x4cc490 with the transfer, the club, byte +0x61, 1, 1, 0); without a transfer (+0x59 = −1) it resubmits with −1, −1. It removes the offer from the list (0x68d1f0) and counts it. Byte +0x61 is pushed in the whole register (the upper bits of whatever was in it: the pointer read or −1). Returns how many.

`contract_manager_season_end_month(club)` (stdcall, ret 4; SEH frame without a destructor on the normal path): the month (0..11) of the date ten days after the end of the season of the club's nation. \n The club's season end date (Date() 0x54a110 and 0x669bd0 with 0), plus 10 days (0x54c5b0), and its month (0x54cfb0). Returns the eax of 0x54cfb0 (the month 0..11).

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::get_free_staff_contract_space(append_only)`: returns the slot in the contract vector (0x50-byte records at [this], capacity +4, count +8). \n Without `append_only`, the first empty slot (person +0 = −1); otherwise (or with no empty slot) the one at the end: when full it grows by 200 at a time (realloc 0x945667, or malloc 0x944e46 without a vector; without memory, box 0x175 and −1) and the count goes up. Returns the index. Both callers (the contract creation 0x4c7560 and 0x4c7950) pass 1.

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::add_staff_contract(person, value)`: takes the appended slot for a new person (hired manager, regen), links the person to it and generates the initial contract. \n The slot at the end (0x4c79a0 with 1); without a slot, nothing. Links the person to the slot (index +0 of her 0x4f-byte record in [0xae2d0c]), puts her id in the contract (+0) and generates the initial contract (0x85e960 with the value). Called by the manager hiring (0x68f9c0, MANAGER_MANAGER::daily_update) and by the regen that signs with a club (0x7a6f10). Returns the original's eax (that of 0x85e960, or the negative index); the callers do not read it.

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::add_decision_date(person, date, slice, type)`: appends an entry to the 14-byte decision date vector; type 1 first adds type 2 reminders from the contract morale. \n Appends to the 14-byte vector [this+0xc] (capacity +0x10, count +0x14; it grows by 100 at a time when the count passes capacity − 4, realloc 0x945667 or malloc 0x944e46; without memory, box 0x103e and nothing) the entry (person id +0, date +4, time slice of the day +0xc, type +0xd). Type 1 is preceded by the type 2 reminders (`decision_reminder_dates`), without a slice (+0xc is left as it is). Called by the offers: the person's decision (0x4cd230, 0x4ce4e0). The date copies (0x417c10, with no other effect) become 8-byte copies.

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::trigger_relegation_clauses(club, league)`: triggers the relegation clauses at a relegated club. \n At the relegated club and at its partner (A/B team), each of the 50 staff and squad members (+0xd7) with a relegation clause still to be triggered in the contract with the club (+0x1f = 1) goes to 2 and the news is posted (0x8e3db0 over [0xde1f54] with type 3).

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::remove_contract_offer(person, club)`: removes the person's first offer to the club. \n The first offer in the list (+0x34) of the person to the club (ids): returns the record reservation (+0x63 ≠ −1: 0x7a81a0 over [0xb7434c] with +0x67, +0x6b), clears the agreed-contract flag if it was agreed (+0x50 = 2: 0x8c5430), leaves the list (0x68d1f0) and the person's pending count (+8 of the 79-byte record in [0xae2d0c]) drops by one.

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::remove_pending_offers_for_staff(person)`: removes all of the person's pending offers. \n With the offers list (+0x34) and pending offers in the person's record (+8 of the 79-byte one in [0xae2d0c]): clears the agreed-contract flag (0x8c5430 over [0xde1f54]) and, from the start of the list, removes each offer of the person (0x68d1f0), decrementing the byte, until it reaches zero.

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::schedule_decision_for_transfer(offer)`: marks the first still-undecided contract offer of the person and club and schedules the decision. \n The first contract offer in the list (+0x34) of the person (+0xc) and the club (+8) of the transfer offer still without a decision (+0x62) is marked (1) and the person's decision is scheduled (0x4cd230 with slot +0x20). Returns whether the person's ability / 500 exceeds the club's reputation.

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::remove_held_offers(person)`: removes from the held offers list (+0x38; cursor +0xa back to the start +2) every item (0x68d1f0) whose +0 is the id `person` (walked with 0x68d1b0). Without a list: nothing.

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::get_squad_placement(person, club)`: the person's place at `club`: 0 none, 1 reserves, 2 first team, 3 at the linked B team, 4 at the main club with a B team. \n Only for player jobs (+0x3d other than 12 and 0x53b620). At her own club (+0x39) when it can have reserves (0x542740): 2 with bit 0 of +0x5e, otherwise 1. The partner club (0x540a50 with 1; the output byte is the person's slot, which keeps her pointer if 0x540a50 does not write it): being A with `club` her own, 4; being B with `club` the partner A, 3. Otherwise by the contract (0x4cbb60 finds it internally in [0xae1050], stored in [0xae1080]): the contract club, which is neither her own nor the partner already seen; with bit 6 of the contract's +0x35 (found again in [this]): at `club` with reserves, 1 with the bit and 2 without; or with the partner (0x540a50) being `club` (or the contract's being `club`), 3 with the bit and 4 without. The game reads only al.

`STAFF_CONTRACT::operator=`: copies the contract (0x50 bytes) from `source` field by field. \n Four dwords, three dwords (+0x10), five bytes (+0x1c), +0x21, the start (+0x25) and end (+0x2d) dates through 0x417c10, the bit-field byte +0x35 in three steps (6 bits, the 7th, the 8th: at the end it is `source`'s), +0x36, +0x3a, +0x3b, +0x3d, +0x3e, +0x3f, +0x40, +0x44, +0x45, +0x49, +0x4a, +0x4e and +0x4f in two steps (low nibble and then the rest). Returns `this`.

`contract_manager_raise_match_morale(person, club, contract)` (stdcall, ret 0xc): raises the contract morale after a match by the rating against the club reputation (up to 10), keeping morale between −100 and 100 and under the grievance cap; clears grievances 4 and 0x10 and checks the request withdrawal. \n With the three and the player record (+0x61): x = (rating +0xb − club reputation +0x80) + 417 × +0x18 − 11680; y = 1 + x × (6.6e-5 if x < 0, otherwise 6.6667e-5), between 0.01 and 2; the gain = ftol((+0x3f + 5) / y), at most 10. The cap: 100 (50 with grievance 2), −50 per grievance 1, 8, 0x20, 0x40, 0x80, 0x100 while the cap does not go below −50. The morale (+0x44) adds the gain within −100 and 100 and stays at or under the cap. Without +0x49: with gain > 5 and morale + gain > 0, or happiness (+0x3d) ≥ 75 − gain, it clears grievances 4 and 0x10 (0x8674e0). Finally it checks the withdrawal of the request (0x867240 with 0). Constants from .rdata; x87 in double precision, like the other contract routines.

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::remove_talks_records(person, manager, club)`: removes the person's talks (and of the club and manager, when given), moving the last one into the gap, then sorts again. \n In the talks vector ([this+0x28], [this+0x2c] records of 21 bytes), each one of the person (+0 = id) and, when given, of the club (+4) and the manager (+8) is overwritten by the last one (5 dwords and a byte), the count goes down and the same place is looked at again. If any are left, it sorts again (qsort 0x945333 with 0x4dc970).

Returns dword +0xc of the contract record (0x50 bytes from [this]) of person `*p`, by the index at +0 of the 79-byte record in [0xae2d0c]. \n 0 without a person, with an id outside [0xae2364], a negative index or a record at address 0.

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::schedule_offer_decision(id, slot)` (SEH only for the local date, with an empty destructor): finds or creates the person's type 3 decision entry and sets the day and time slice of the answer: by the offer deadline, or without an offer by today and the contract end; at most 14 days ahead. \n The person's type 3 decision entry (find_type3_decision, with the limit of today + 14; without one, a new one at today + 1 + draw(5), slice 2, through 0x4cd6d0). With the offer's slot (0x8c61e0): the answer deadline (0x8cc5b0: days × 3 + slices) against what is left (days until the date × 3 + slices, 0x54cdb0); the smaller, at least 1, becomes the date (today + quotient of ÷3) and the slice (+ remainder; passing 2 it goes to the next day); an offer with +0x2f and fewer than 4 days: today + 4 + draw(2). Without a slot (−1): once the date is reached, it becomes today and the slice goes up (up to the day's [0xae2c88]); if the person's contract ([this] + 80 × index from the 79-byte record) ends before today + 180, today + 4 + draw(4). At the end, the date is no later than today + 14, and +0x1c goes up.

Returns the category 1..8 of player `p` in contract `c`. \n Without a player sheet (+0x61), 7; without a contract, 4; a type 5 contract (+0x35 & 0x3f), 8; otherwise by the squad status (+0x4f >> 4, 0..6; above, 7), the happiness (+0x3d, signed), the age (+0x18), the ambition (+0x57) and the sheet's reputation (+0xb, +0xd).

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::post_transfer_listed_news(player, club)` (SEH frame for the local list), called by the transfer request (0x4d8610), the player put up for sale (0x842320), the news (0x784100) and 0x4dc3a0: posts news item 0xbea of a player on the transfer list, with the price and the strongest interested clubs, to the interested human clubs. \n Without a player, a player sheet (+0x61), a club or the staff (+0xcf): nothing. Without a contract with the club (0x4cf5f0): nothing. The news item 0xbea (local): 0 the club, 1 the player, 2..4 his +0x33 of +4, +8 and +0xc, 5 the staff, 6..8 its +0x33, 9 the contract +0x45, 10 the high nibble of +0x4f, 11 the positions mask (0x5b7d20), 12 a draw of 2 (0x90cfc0). \n The price: the value (+0x52) with a human club, when the player is not on the club's list (0x5444a0) or the contract has nibble 1; otherwise the asking price (0x4d1600) × (draw of 0x29 × [0x967898] + [0x9689b0]) truncated, rounded down to 10 thousand (between 10 thousand and 200 thousand, exclusive), 100 thousand (below 1 million), 250 thousand (below 5 million) or 1 million; 13 the price. From 500 thousand up: the interested clubs (0x842180), up to 30, the computer ones and the human ones with a budget (0x598800) ≥ price × [0x9689c0]; sorted by reputation (+0x80); 14 = up to 3; 15.. the ids, with 1 (in place 13) if the 2nd repeats the 1st and 2 (in 12) if the 3rd repeats one of them; finally the "off the list" in the next place. `Media::rate_player_form_for_story(player, club, contract, type, mode, weight)`: the player's rating (x87, in st0) for a media story kind. \n Without a contract, the player's contract with the club (0x4cf5f0); without any, 0. Without a log, it allocates 20 (0x944e46; without memory, box 0x6e11 and the end); when full, it grows by 20 (realloc 0x945667; box 0x6e1c).

`Media::expire_story_log()`: removes the stories older than the limit, moving the last one into the gap, then sorts again. \n Each story in the log older than the limit (today − 100 days; the team one, type 0xbdf, today − (40 + draw(40)), one draw 0x90cfc0 per such story on each pass; dates from 0x54c8e0 over [0xae2c90]) is overwritten by the last one (23 bytes), the count goes down and the same place is looked at again. If any are left, it re-sorts (qsort with 0x757ee0). Without a log, nothing.

`Media::has_logged_story(a, b, type, subtype, since)`: tells whether a story is in the log. \n The team story (type 0xbdf): a linear search for one of type 0xbdf with the id of `b` (+0xc) and the `subtype` (word +0x11), without looking at `a` or the date: 1 if found. The others: a binary search (bsearch 0x946464 with 0x757ee0) by the key {id of `a` or −1, id of `b`, type, subtype} (the default date 0x54a110 in the key, which the comparison does not read); found and without `since`, 1; with `since`, 1 if the story is not older than it. Otherwise 0. `b` cannot be null (the original reads it without checking).

`Media::add_transfer_interest(player, club, fee, valuation)`: if the {player, club} key is missing, appends the interest and sorts again. \n With the interest vector ([this+0xc], capacity +0x10, count +0x14; 25-byte records), it searches (bsearch 0x946464 with 0x757ea0) for the key {player id, club id or −1}: already there, nothing. Otherwise it appends: player id (+0), club id (+4, read without checking), today's date (+8, 0x417c10 from [0xae2c90]), 0 (+0x10, the rumour has not come out yet), the `fee` up to 50,000,000 (+0x11) and the `valuation` × 100 truncated (+0x15, _ftol 0x945640); the count goes up and it re-sorts (qsort with 0x757ea0). Without a vector, it allocates 20 (0x944e46; without memory, box 0x665d and the end); when full, it grows by 20 (realloc 0x945667; box 0x6668). The key's default date (0x54a110) is on the stack, as in the original.

`Media::remove_transfer_interest(person)`: removes the person's interests, moving the last one into the gap, then sorts again. \n In the interest vector ([this+0xc], [this+0x14] records of 25 bytes), each one of the person (+0 = id) is overwritten by the last one (6 dwords and a byte), the count goes down and the same place is looked at again. If any are left, it re-sorts (qsort 0x945333 with 0x757ea0).

`media_queue_player_apology_news(player, club, story)` (stdcall, ret 0xc; SEH frame without a destructor), called by the story effects (0x736c00) and the reply to the player's story (0x741020): builds news item 0xbdb and sends it to the club's manager. \n With the player, the sheet (+0x61) and the club, news item 0xbdb in a local (0x77bbe0 with 0) with the data 0 = id, 1 to 3 = the names (+0x33 of +4, +8 and +0xc; without the third, −1), 4 = club id, 5 = the story, 6 = 0 and 7 = the variant: draw(4) for stories 0, 2 to 5, 13, 14, 17 and 35 (table 0x72bd2c), otherwise 0; it goes to the club's manager (0x7861e0).

Draws a former international as the pundit for `club` (or to talk about `subject`), weighted by nation reputation and caps (`this` is not read). \n 150 rounds; in each it draws people (0x90cfc0 with [0xae2364], 110 bytes in [0xae23bc]) until it finds one aged (+0x18) ≥ 37, with national team caps (+0x22) ≥ 50, a sheet (+0x69), no club (+0x39) if he has a contract (+0x61) and who is not the club's manager (+0xcf); the 100th try ends the round. The weight is a draw of the nation's reputation (+0x1a, word +0x8e) × caps, doubled if he is from the subject's nation (without a subject: he must be from the club's nation, +0x53). From another nation: the reputation must beat 6500 + a draw of 100, the sheet's +0xc ≥ 6000 and the subject must not dislike him (0x547840). The one with the highest weight is kept (the first accepted always gets in). Without a club and without a subject: 0.

`player_search_get_club_target_rating(club, *base, *forced)` (cdecl): the rating the club looks for in players: a base from reputation, money, nation and league, by bands, and adjustments for squad size and wealth; at least 500. \n The base (without `forced`): the reputation (+0x80), the money one (+0x77 × 0.43 − 430, up to 10000, if greater than the reputation), the nation one (+0x57: +0x69 × 500, if greater than reputation / 500) and the league one (+0x1db in [0xae23d0], 0x6b bytes: +0x69 × 600, likewise), weighted and / 16; half at a non-professional club (+0x64 ≠ 1). Without `forced`, by the squad (0x53c590) and the wealth band of the finances (0x5a0590 of [0xae2a38], 0x5986b0) for clubs with a nation in [0xadadfc]: a short squad (< 16) halves; < 20 halves, or 2/3 for the poor; otherwise it shrinks by the shortage of players compared with the nation (+0x69 × 1.35 + 20) and wealth pulls it (−2..2: × 0.909 or − 1000, × 0.952 or − 500, nothing, × 1.0125 or + 125, × 1.025 or + 250). At least 500. The base goes into `*base` (if not null). The floating-point arithmetic is in f64 (the game's x87 at 53 bits).

`PLAYER_SEARCH::get_scout`: returns the search's scout: the index at +0x180 (> −1) in the people vector [0xae23bc] (110 bytes), if it still matches the stored names and date (0x53e990 with +0x174, +0x178, +0x17c and the date at +0x184); otherwise 0.

Without an assignment: both nations with +0x7f = 2, the same region (+0x76) as the club's nation, the nation not foreign to the scout (0x53d980 with 1) or the club's scouts covering the nation (0x7f9190 of [0xb74448]). `load_game_data(path)` (cdecl, ~14.6 KB, SEH): loads the whole saved game. Returns 1 if it loaded. 
 Disk (0x7a1820(0) < 25 sets [0xdd7134]) and memory ([0x9cd1fc] and 0x7a1710() < 50 set [0xdd7138]); the temporary folder (0x90bde0 "CM3_TEMP"); the CD (`check_game_cd`); a null `path` gives the "Error" box 0x233b. The database: 0x528080 if [0xae23a8] ≠ 0 and 0x524d10(path, 1) (the answer is not looked at). 
 "Loading game data" and the progress bar 0x802f80 (step 0x2d); clears the `*.tmp` files (0x90cd50), checks their space (0x933860, in MB, 0 becomes 25) against the disk, unpacks (0x933320; on failure: "Disk Space Error" 0x2382). 
 `general.dat` (0x9326e0 reading, 0x15, type 4; without it: "Load Game Error" 0x2397): the version ([0xdd7110]); the summary (|v| ≥ 0x3e023; 0xf70 bytes up to 0x3e026 with the play time zeroed, 0xf74 after that, with [0xdd7140] = its play time); [0xdd7144] = time(); the unique id, the database size, the dates and times (the game's in a local), the leagues, the default nation ([0xae2d08] = nation id, or 0 if < 0), the runtime data of people ([0xae2d0c], 0x4f × [0xae2d10]; old saves converted by `convert_staff_state`; |v| < 0x3e018 clears bit 7 of +0xb of the first [0xae2364]), of clubs ([0xae2d14], 6 × [0xae2d18] = [0xae235c]; |v| < 0x3e022: −1, 0, 0) and the reputation ([0xae2d1c], 4 × [0xae235c]; |v| < 0x3e022 does not read it and calls 0x53db40(1)). A failed read: "Load Game Error" with the line and the field's text, item closed; without memory: "Error" and the game closes. 
 Steps 4..=0x2d (`LOAD_STEPS`, disk and memory checked before each): at step 5, the game date (0x417c10 into 0xae2c90); before step 9, the last 16 managers with +0x5f = 5 are undone (News, HUMAN_MANAGER, CONTRACT_MANAGER, NationalTeams, Staff_Records; empty names, date 1/0/1966, +0x24 and +0x39 = 0, 0x7ff990); after 0x22, 0x7e61c0; before the last one, |v| < 0x3e032 passes each person through 0x538bc0. 
 FIFA rules (0x839760, |v| ≥ 0x3e039); 0xdd70a0 = the game date; [0xdd711c] = [0xdd7130] = 1, [0xa801bc] = 0; with [0x9b5980], it switches the rules on or off by the date of [0xae2330] (0x58a890(1) when switching on); without `auto_setup.cfg`, the CD search at the end. 
 The original's branches for 0x3e042 ≤ |v| < 0x3e038 (0xd-byte records) and 0x3e042 ≤ |v| < 0x3e034 (0xc) are unreachable (the comparisons are chained with `jge`): they are left out. The original's two-pass loop ([esp+0x24]; the 1st only sets the total 0x2d) runs the body once.

`create_game_from_setup_file(cfg, qst)` (cdecl, ~3 KB): reads the configuration file `cfg` (`auto_setup.cfg` or `quick_start.cfg`: database, stats, foreground and background leagues, language, engine, bids, holiday), creates the game and, with `qst`, saves the quick start `CM3_QSTART\<qst>.qst` and frees everything; without `qst`, puts the human manager on holiday at a drawn club. Returns 1 if it created the game. 
 Folders CM3_TEMP (0x90bde0, only copied, as in the original) and CM3_DATA. A null `cfg` or one that does not open (0x945b00 "r"): the "Error" box (0x1c13, 0x1c1b) and 0. 
 Each line (0x90cba0, 1000-byte buffer) goes through 0x90bb70 and loses its spaces (one by one, like the original's `strcpy`); the value is searched for with `strstr` (0x945a60) after the prefix: `DATABASE=` NORMAL/MINIMUM/MAXIMUM → 0x5d7c60(1/2/4) in [0xae3138]; `MATCH_STATS=` NORMAL/SMALL/LARGE → 0x200/0x400/0x800; `FOREGROUND_LEAGUES=` and `BACKGROUND_LEAGUES=`: on the first one, without a database ([0xae23a8] = 0), it loads the database (0x524d50, CM3_DATA; a failure stops the game), applies it (0x5d8480), zeroes byte +0x11c of the nations, [0xae2d00], [0xae2d04] (and [0xae2d08] for the foreground) and builds the key nations (0x667150; a failure stops the game); then, for each league in the table 0xb63d60 (0x23 of 0x48 bytes) with a nation and +8, if the name (0x5454c0) is on the line or 0x839340 accepts it: foreground, flag 0/1 → ((~options & 2) | 1) << 1 and counts (+[0xae2d00] only from 0, +[0xae2d04]) and the 1st that matches by `strncmp` (0x946fa0) or 0x839340 becomes [0xae2d08]; background, 0 → ((~options & 2) << 1) | 1 (+[0xae2d00]) and 2 → the same (−[0xae2d04]); `LANGUAGE=`: the 1st language i (table 0x9eb244, 19) that exists (0x66ea50), is English, there is no database or the database has it (0x535930), and is on the line: 0x5d8020(i) and 0x5d8480; `ENABLE_MATCH_ENGINE=` YES/NO → byte [0xa5a390]; `ENABLE_COMPUTER_BIDS=` → [0x9cd1f8]; `ON_HOLIDAY=` → the manager's holiday. 
 Closes the file; with no league flagged, no foreground league, no default nation or one without bit 2: 0. [0xdd7124] = [0xdd713c] = 1; creates the game (0x828110(qst ≠ 0); a failure stops the game). With `qst`: 0x945b13 (CM3_QSTART, `qst`, ".qst"), 0x82e430(path, 0x17), 0x82ff40(1) and 1. 
 Without it: "auto_setup_game" in [0xae3138]+0x113, [0xdd7130] = 1, the date in 0xdd70a0; if the current human (0xb74c26 + 0x300 × (i16)[0xb77c7a]) already has a person, 0. Otherwise, the 1st of the last 16 people (0xae23bc, 0x6e) with +0x5f = 0 (without a table, box 0x39b3 and person 0) becomes the human: text +0xc zeroed, date +0x10 (0x54a130: 1, 0, 1966, −1), +0x18 = 1966, +0x24 and +0x39 = 0, +0x5f = 1, 0x5fb810 and 0x5fd2f0(holiday, 0) on [0xb63c98]; it draws (0x90cfc0) clubs (0xae23b4, 0x245) until one that is not a national side (0x53b900), with a nation of a foreground league (bit 2) and accepted by 0x544820: its nation into +0x1a, the names (0x539c60, 0x53a1b0) into +4 and +8, and 0x826f20(person, club). Returns 1.

`save_game_data(path, a4)` (cdecl, ~6.8 KB, SEH): saves the whole game into the container `path` (a4 0x16 `.sav`, 0x17 `.qst`; type 3 with bit 0x8000 of `game.cfg` [[0xae3138]+4], otherwise 4 = RLE): the database, general.dat, the subsystem saves in the original order with disk and memory checks between them, the packed *.tmp files and the FIFA rules; on a network game it writes to temp_save_file and renames. Returns 1 if it saved. 
 [0xdd7110] = 0xfffc1fb9 (the save version). On a network game (bit 0x20000000), before anything, disk (0x7a1820(0) < 25) sets [0xdd7134] and memory ([0x9cd1fc] and 0x7a1710() < 1) sets [0xdd7138]: deletes `path` and returns 0. 
 Temporary folder (0x90bde0 "CM3_TEMP"); a null `path` gives the "Error" box (0x2958). The working path is `path` or, on a network game, the same with the name `temp_save_file` (0x944cff/0x945b13); if it already exists (0x90c120) and cannot be removed (0x94643a = −1), returns 0. With bit 0x40000000, disk and memory again (deleting `path`). 
 0x524d30 (the database, step 1 of the save); disk and memory (deleting the working path); the translated "Saving game data" and the progress bar 0x802f80 (step 1 of 0x25). 
 `general.dat` (0x9326e0): 16 fields (the version, the 0xf74-byte summary 0x591f80, the unique id, the database size, the dates and times, the leagues, the default nation or −1, the runtime data of people, clubs and reputation); a write error gives the "Disk Space Error" box with the field's line and closes the item. 
 Steps 2..=0x24 (`SAVE_STEPS`): disk and memory (before 0x11, without deleting and with memory < 25), the progress bar and the subsystem's `save`; 0x25: packs the `*.tmp` files (0x933610). 
 Hall of fame (0x5f00c0, outside the save), FIFA rules (0x8395b0); on a network game, swaps the old save for the new one (0x945ba4); [0xdd7130] = 1, [0xa801bc] = 0 and the date of the last save (0xdd70a0). 
 The original's local date ([esp+0x1758], 0x54a110, empty destructor 0x5a53c0 in the SEH) is not used: it is left out. The original's loop ([esp+0x11c] from 1 to 2) runs the body once, with the total 0x25. The summary is a zeroed buffer here; in the original, what 0x591f80 does not write (the club of the 16 non-human managers, the rest of the texts) is leftover from its stack, saved into `general.dat`.

`check_saved_game_file(path)` (cdecl): file box filter for saved games: 1 if the container has id 0x16 (`.sav`, 0x9331c0), otherwise 2. \n The original only sets `ax`: the upper 16 bits of `eax` are those of the id answer, as here. A null path is the Setup.cpp error 0x3a1b ("Error" box): the port calls the original.

`check_quick_start_file(path)` (cdecl): file box filter for quick starts: 1 if the container has id 0x17 (`.qst`) and the saved version is the exe's (0x838eb0), otherwise 2. \n Only `ax` is set: the upper 16 bits of `eax` are those of the last call (the id, or the version). A null path: Setup.cpp error 0x3a6d, the port calls the original.

`valid_saved_game_version(path)` (cdecl): opens the container's `general.dat` item, reads the version and the summary and returns 1 if the summary's version text is the exe's. \n Opens the item (0x9326e0 reading, a4 0x15, type 4), reads the saved version (4 bytes) and the save summary (0xf70 bytes if |version| < 0x3e027, otherwise 0xf74) and returns 1 if the summary's version text (+0x7d0) equals the exe's (0x90d130), otherwise 0. Each failed read gives the "Load Game Error" box (Setup.cpp 0x3a36, 0x3a3d, 0x3a48, 0x3a55) and 0. As in the original, on success the item is NOT closed (the ZFILE and the file stay open). The original's SEH frame only protects the local date (0x54a110, no destructor), which falls inside the summary (+0xf64) and is overwritten by the read.

`save_fifa_transfer_rules(save)` (cdecl): writes the last item of the save, `fifa_transfer_rules.zip`: 2 bytes, [0xae233c] and the rule in force [0xa83608], then `zclose`. \n The item is opened with 0x9326e0 writing, a4 0x16, type 4 (in an already created container its header applies). A null path, an item that does not open or a failed write: the "Error" box (Setup.cpp 0x3b24, 0x3b2c, 0x3b32, 0x3b38); on the writes, the item is closed after the box. The original returns nothing (`eax` is leftover).

`load_fifa_transfer_rules(save)` (cdecl): reads the 2 bytes of the `fifa_transfer_rules.zip` item (0x9326e0 reading) into [0xae233c] and [0xa83608]; if [0xae233c] = 1, the rule in force [0xa83608] becomes 5. Closes the item. \n Errors: the "Error" box (Setup.cpp 0x3b4f, 0x3b57, 0x3b5d, 0x3b63), as in the save.

`free_game_data(screen)` (cdecl): releases the screens and destroys the subsystems held in globals, in the original order; returns 1. \n The screen manager (0xb74450) releases the screens (0x7ff5f0) and, if `screen` ≠ 0, also 0x7fc5e0; 0x6d5b50; then each subsystem kept in a global, in the original's order: destructor (thiscall) + `delete` (0x944c94) and the global zeroed; the loose vectors through `free` (0x9452ca); two objects through the virtual destructor (vtable[0](1)); the `*.tmp` files of the temporary folder (0x90cd50), [0xae2338], the database tables (0x528080), the game date (0x54a130: 1, 0, 2001, −1) and three flags zeroed.

`TRAINING_MANAGER::update_coach_assignments(club, manager)`, called by the coach hirings and departures (0x4ce4e0, 0x4cf720, 0x8c9720, the regen 0x7aaeb0) and by the club change (0x8b2470): updates the six training staff slots of the human manager and recomputes each category rating. \n Without a manager and with a club without a human (0x600a50 with 1, 1, 0, 0), or a national side club (0x53b900): nothing. A null manager: the club's (+0xcf). The human's staff (0x8b4cd0, six 9-byte slots): (1) the slot whose coach has no non-player sheet (+0x69) or is neither the assistant (0x53cb80) nor one of the 5 coaches (0x53cc30) is emptied; (2) the assistant and the coaches with a sheet that are not in the slots go into the first empty one with all five categories (0x01010101 and 1); (3) each flagged category gets its rating: 0 (goalkeepers, sheet +0x10) (chance − sheet +0x12 + 21) / 2; 1 (tactics, +0x21 and +0x10) (chance + chance + +0x12) / 3; 2 (+0x10) (chance + +0xe + +0x12) / 3; 3 (+0x10) (chance + +0x12) / 2; 4 (+0x11) the chance (divisions truncated toward zero; the chance from 0x544410), the signed byte divided by the divisor for the number of flagged categories (1.0 to 2.0, float), truncated and clamped to 1..20.

`TRAINING_MANAGER::reassign_squad_schedules(manager, old, new)`, when the human manager changes club (0x690890 and 0x68f9c0/0x69ebc0, manager_manager.cpp): reassigns the training schedules of the old and new squads. \n The old club's squad (0x541f90, 50): each valid person (id below [0xae2364]) gets load 50 (0x62c660) and slot 6 (goalkeeper with 15 or more, sheet +0xf) or 1 in the training entry; without a sheet, the box (line 0x34c). With a new club: of the manager's ten schedules, the last one of type 6 (+0x15) is the goalkeepers' and the last one of type 1 the general one; each player of the new squad with a sheet goes to the goalkeepers' schedule (goalkeeper with 15 or more, if there is one), otherwise the general one (if there is one), otherwise slot 1, with the schedule's load (0x8b4f60) on the fitness sheet; finally the training staff (0x8b2880 with the new club and the manager).

`TRAINING_MANAGER::update_player_training(person, skip)`, called by the player initialisation for the match (0x6eaea0, match_man.cpp, with 0: every player of every match), by a new injury (0x62d250) and by the screens: brings the player's training weeks up to date (up to 30). 
 A null person (line 0x18a), without the sheet (0x195) or without a schedule (0x8b39f0 null, 0x1a3): the "Error" box; an id from [0xae2364] on: nothing. A player of a human manager's club without flag 0x20 in +5 of the training entry: the flag, the schedule slot (the goalkeepers' one, type 6, for a goalkeeper with 15 or more; otherwise the general one, type 1; otherwise 1) and its load (0x8b4f60) on the fitness sheet (0x62c660). Weeks = training week (+0x688d) − the entry's (+1); none and without `skip`: nothing. With the flag and the club no longer with a human manager: clears the flag, load 50, slot 6 or 1 and the position training stops (0x8b4450 with 0). 
 Up to 30 weeks: brings the entry up to date; each category (0..4) has the weight level × 2 + 60 + (coach factor − 100) / 5 (0..200) and, per week, progress rolls: up 1 with weight above 100, draw(210 − weight) < 20, value below (+0x58) / 3 and draw(|value| × 2 + 14) < 10; otherwise down 1 with weight below 110, draw(weight + 60) < 20, value above −7 and above (+0x5b) / 3 − 6 and the same last draw (goalkeeper with 19 or more: only with draw(4), or draw(2) in category 4, at zero). 
 The position training items (0x8b4b20, 8-byte items: +4 the mask, +6 the rating, +7 the rate) advance per week (or once, with `skip` in the mask): with a positive rate, draw(rate) < 5 gives rating + 2 (up to 20) and the player may complain (club contract 0x4cf5f0 without 0x8000 in +0x45: by a rate above 50 or an aptitude 0x8b4770 below 12, with +0x5b below 15, draw(+0x5b) < 10 and no injury 0x62c400: flag 0x8000 (0x867700), −5 on +0x44 (−100..100) and 0x5885c0); with a negative rate, draw(−rate) < 5 gives rating − 2 and, below 1, the item ends (rate 0, rating 1). It applies the progress (0x8b2be0) and, with finished items, removes them from the list (the last one into the gap) and re-sorts (qsort 0x945333 with 0x8b4e00).

`TRAINING_MANAGER::get_player_schedule(person)`, called by the people's daily update (game_daily_staff_update 0x5ce2d0), by 0x5d6aa0 and by update_player_training (0x8b1750): returns the player's training schedule. \n A null person or one without the sheet: the "Error" box (line 0x6ad) and 0. At a human manager's club (contract 0x4cf5a0, kept in [0xae1080]; manager +0xcf among the last 16 ids): injured (0x62c400 = 2), the human's schedule 1, this + 0x4d8 + 0x60e × ([0xae2364] − id − 1); otherwise the one of the training entry's slot (+0, outside 0..9 slot 1); outside the 16, the box (line 0x68f) and 0. Otherwise: injured, schedule 0 (this); otherwise this + 0x9b × slot (signed).

`TRAINING_SCHEDULE::get_category_level(category)`: returns the level of the schedule's category (+4 + category, signed), in al; the upper bytes of eax keep the sign-extended category (movsx), as in the original. Called by update_player_training (0x8b1750, the five categories of each update).

`TRAINING_MANAGER::remove_or_restore_training_progress(person, restore)`: takes the progress stored in the training entry off the attributes or puts it back, around the player attribute normalisations (0x538bc0 and 0x538ec0: on ageing in the people's daily update 0x5ce2d0, in the young regen 0x7abac0 and on load), which take the progress off before and put it back after. \n A null person or one without the sheet: the "Error" box (line 0x621). Taking off (`restore` = 0): keeps the five progress nibbles of the training entry in 0xde1f3c..0xde1f40 (category 3, 2, 4, 0, 1) and applies the negated progress (0x8b2be0); restoring: applies the kept one.
